# baffinbay_ca_certificate (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay CA Certificate by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_ca_certificate" "origin" {
  id = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the CA certificate to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded CA certificate chain returned by the API.
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
